retrieval.note: This document is only 308 tokens, so all 5 retrieved chunks together cover almost the entire NDA -- a representative EASY case for retrieval, not a hard one. See examples/case_failure for a harder one.

runtime_validation.checked_against: the exact context_text shown above, not the full document
runtime_validation.meaning: The cited quote is a genuine, exact substring of what the model was shown. This check says nothing about whether the LABEL is correct -- see runtime_vs_offline_scoring below.

offline_scoring.gold_evidence_text: ____________________ , agrees that, in consideration for being shown or told about certain trade secrets or property belonging to Navidec, Incorporated, ____________________, shall not disclose or cause to be disclosed, disseminated or distributed any information concerning said trade secret or property to any person, entity, business or other individual or company without the prior written permission of Navidec, Incorporated.
offline_scoring.scored_by: evaluation/evidence_matching.py (evidence_evaluator_v2), offline only -- the model never saw this gold data

runtime_vs_offline_scoring: Two separate, non-overlapping checks run on this case: the RUNTIME validator (pipeline/evidence_validator.py) only confirms the quote is real and in-context -- it has no gold label and cannot know if 'Contradiction' is the right answer. The OFFLINE scorer (evaluation/) has the gold label and confirms it. In production only the runtime check exists; the offline check is what builds the metrics in the final report.

reviewer_decision.note: This case comes from the offline E20 TEST evaluation run (2,091 cases, scored in bulk), not from a live reviewed session through the backend's reviewer decision API (POST /review/{review_id}/items/{item_id}/decision). No individual reviewer decision exists for it. See backend/routes/review.py for that live flow.
